1. By way of present application filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the applicant/petitioner seeks condonation of delay of 68 days in re-filing the petition.
2. Issue notice.
Learned APP for the State accepts notice.
3. For the reasons stated in the application, the same is allowed and the delay of 68 days in re-filing is condoned.
4. Application is disposed of.

1. By way of present application filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C., the petitioner/applicant seeks regular bail in FIR No. 96/2021 registered under Sections 376(3)/376DA IPC and Sections 5(g)/6 POCSO Act at P.S. Burari.
2. Issue notice.
3. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks some time to file the Status Report.
Let the same be placed on record before the next date of
